MODEL CARD & DATA PROVENANCE

How well does the AI perform?

These metrics show how well each model predicts artificial labels. They do not measure real antiviral effectiveness.

The ranking engine is a real random-forest regressor trained on generated structures and artificial activity labels. The three target names identify separate synthetic response functions. They do not imply that the models learned real viral biology.

Study protocol

01 · DATA

2,400 generated structures

RDKit validates generated SMILES and computes eight physicochemical descriptors plus 256 Morgan fingerprint bits (radius 2). No patient records or measured antiviral data are included.

02 · LEARNING

Molecule-disjoint partitions

1,680 fitting records, 360 validation structures and 360 unseen screening structures. Random partitions use fixed seeds. This is not scaffold, temporal or external validation.

03 · ENDPOINT

Synthetic pIC50 regression

Each model learns an artificial descriptor-based response function with added noise. Higher pIC50 corresponds mathematically to lower IC50. Neither value is an experimental measurement.

04 · EXPLANATION

AI linked to source evidence

MiniLM selects relevant study statements for an extractive summary. DistilBERT extracts answers from retrieved evidence. Both run locally via Transformers.js. Selection can be incorrect, so source excerpts are shown.

Applicability and uncertainty

Training similarity is the largest Tanimoto similarity to a synthetic training structure. A value below 0.4 receives an exploratory flag; this threshold is a display heuristic, not a validated applicability boundary. Tree SD is uncalibrated disagreement between the 64 trees and must not be read as a confidence interval. No model is provided for an arbitrary new virus or sequence.

All metrics describe performance on an artificial dataset only. No claims of antiviral activity, safety, clinical compatibility or therapeutic benefit are supported.

SYNTHETIC PLACEHOLDERS - NO EXPERIMENT PERFORMED. These fabricated values illustrate how future test results could be displayed. They are generated independently of the model, do not validate its rankings and must be replaced by real measurements before research interpretation.

All concentration endpoints use µM. Values show mean ± sample SD from three simulated values, not biological replicates. Selectivity index (SI) = CC50 / EC50 and is dimensionless. Illustrative ranges are not target-specific estimates.

ML RANKCOMPOUNDIC50 PLACEHOLDER (µM)EC50 PLACEHOLDER (µM)CC50 PLACEHOLDER (µM)SI PLACEHOLDEREXPERIMENT STATUS

IC50: half-maximal biochemical inhibition endpoint. EC50: half-maximal cellular effect endpoint. CC50: half-maximal cytotoxicity endpoint. These endpoint labels provide a reporting template only; no assay system, mechanism or activity is established by these fixtures.

REPRODUCIBILITY

Screening history

Each run records its target context, model artifact hash, candidate set, ranking endpoint and timestamp. Records are stored in this browser and are not shared with a server.
